definitions: An international treaty on climate change, adopted in 2015, covering climate change mitigation, adaptation, and finance.
A legally binding international treaty on climate change with the goal of limiting global warming to well below 2, preferably to 1.5 degrees Celsius, compared to pre-industrial levels.
examples: The Paris Agreement aims to strengthen the global response to the threat of climate change.
Nations committed to their targets under the Paris Agreement.
The Paris Agreement entered into force on 4 November 2016.
